endpoints_summary.summary: Retrieve the impact test result for a SAST rule extension.

endpoints.summary: Retrieve the impact test result for a SAST rule extension.

details.description:
Get the test result of a Snyk Code project to understand the impact of the input SAST Rule Extension.

#### Required permissions

- `group.rule_extension.read`

parameters.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Unique identifier for group in request path
parameters.name: group_id

200.description: Returns the test results of the input SAST rule extension against a Snyk Code project.

details.summary: Retrieve the impact test result for a SAST rule extension.

oneOf.description: A string containing the link’s URL.

href.description: A string containing the link’s URL.

meta.description: Free-form object that may contain non-standard information.

file_path.description: The relative path to the primary file associated with the finding

priority_score.description: The calculated priority score for the finding, indicating its relative importance. Scores range from 0 to 1000.

rule_id.description: The SARIF result.ruleId for the finding, in the format "<language>/<short_rule_name>" (e.g. "javascript/XSS"). The language prefix can be stripped by the consumer to derive the short rule name.

ProjectID.description: The relevant uuid for the project against which to run the test.

SastRuleExtensionTypes.description: The type of the SAST rule extensions determine the Snyk SAST analysis behavior against the input fully qualified name.

count.description: The total number of findings added as a result of the rule extension.

TestResultsType.description: The type identifier for the "results" resource.

count.description: The total number of findings removed as a result of the rule extension.

TestRuleKeys.description: Array of rule keys for the impact test.

SastTestChangeItemLocation.description: Code region where the finding was found.

total_count.description: The total number of findings added and removed as a result of the rule extension.

SastRuleExtensionFullyQualifiedName.description: The fully qualified name of a function that performs sanitization in your codebase. Should Snyk SAST analysis detect this function being used, issues for the given rule will not be raised.

ProjectCommitSha.description: The relevant commit sha for the project against which the test was run.

OrgID.description: The org id for the relevant project against which to run the test.

id.description: The test id of the resource.
